subject: [PATCH v2] mm: memcontrol: fix NULL pointer deref from high_work_func() on dying memcg

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt
reviews.summary: Reviewer pointed out that css_tryget() is not safe to use after percpu_ref_exit(), and suggested using the online variant css_tryget_online() instead, which is known to be safe in this context.
reviews.raw_body:
css_tryget() is not safe after percpu_ref_exit() which can happen here. Only
css_tryget_online() is safe.

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch fixes a null pointer dereference in the high_work_func() function when dealing with a dying memory control group (memcg). The issue arises because the work itself keeps the memcg allocated, but not from going deep into destruction. To fix this, the patch modifies the reclaim_high function to avoid sending a barely allocated memcg down the reclaim stack.
